messages:
OpsBot: INCIDENT detected: gpu-pool primary-east1-gpu-a queue length 1,389 (warn=200). Autoscaler failing to attach nodes for 12m. Error sample: "quotaExceeded: requested 8 gpus, available 0". Severity: P1. Paging oncall: @Oncall Pager.

Oncall Pager: paging Alice M and Brad S — please acknowledge. link: https://infra.ops/incident/1973001234 :rotating_light:

Alice M: acked. I'm pulling logs now. first pass: many requests in queued state, token generation stalled, timeouts ~30s.

Brad S: acked. quick check — is this the new autoscaler loop change merged yesterday?

Camila R: I saw some rollouts. The new max-node-attach logic rejects when spare capacity < 2. Could be clashing with regional quotas.

Dinesh K: I'm looking at cloud quota API — east1 has 0 spare GPUs for our project, requests are being denied. autoscaler shows repeated AttachError with message 'insufficient quota'.

Alice M: customer impact: some users are seeing 503s and throttling. Support reports multiple customers with increased latency >10s. Support Bot, any specific customer list?

Support Bot: Customers affected (sample): AcmeMaps (high qps), NimbusChat (background embeddings), DocuFlow (batch transforms). Severity flags: AcmeMaps = high, NimbusChat = medium, DocuFlow = medium.

Brad S: mitigation options brainstorm: 1) enable cross-region spill routing to west1 immediately, 2) lower per-request batch sizes to reduce in-flight GPU usage, 3) throttle low-priority tenants at the load balancer, 4) request emergency quota from cloud provider (slow).

Lina T: recommend emergency routing to west1 + temporary tenant throttles. We should avoid global switch that breaks affinity. Can we enable routing only for new requests (no migration of KV caches)?

Camila R: yes — routing policy 'spill_route_new' exists. It will steer new requests to west1-compatible model variants; KV cache remains warm in east1 for active sessions.

Marc V: I'm on the runbook for cross-region routing. Steps:
```
# enable spill routing to west1
curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/v1/routing/policy -d '{"name":"spill_route_new","action":"route","region":"west1","conditions":{"pool":"primary-east1-gpu-a","queue_length_gt":200}}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```
Apply now?

Alice M: execute now. Also reduce batch_size for generator pool from 16 -> 8:
```
# patch runtime config
PATCH /runtime/configs/generator-pool
{ "batch_size": 8 }
```

Brad S: I'm toggling tenant throttle for non-SLA customers (policy low-priority = throttle 30%). Doing via rate-limit service.

Dinesh K: sending request to cloud console for emergency GPUs as backup, but ETA ~45-60m.

OpsBot: ACTION LOG: Oncall Alice M set routing policy "spill_route_new" at 1973001302. Reaction :white_check_mark:.

Alice M: routing policy applied. metrics: new request proportion to west1 rising to 18% in 30s. queue length in east1 dropped 9% so far.

Camila R: batch_size patch applied 1973001355. In-flight token usage down ~22%.

Lina T: tenant throttle applied. Observability: token cost per-tenant chart shows low-priority tenants dropping usage by ~28%.

Marc V: FYI — we saw 7 attach errors in autoscaler logs that look like race condition between attach retries and quota checks. I'll open a follow PR to add backoff.

Alice M: update for customers: support please send initial incident note — what to include: affected regions (east1), mitigation (spill to west1 + throttles), estimated restoration for full capacity (45-60m pending quota).

Support Bot: Draft message created in #support-desk: "We are experiencing increased latency and some 503s for workloads served from east1. We have routed new requests to an alternate region and applied temporary throttles for low-priority tenants. Engineers are working on restoring capacity; ETA ~45-60 minutes."

Brad S: monitoring metrics: error-rate peaked at +12% above baseline at 1973001290, now trending down to +4%. Latency p95 from 1.2s -> 8.6s at peak, now ~2.1s.

Dinesh K: cloud provider responded to quota request — they can provision +12 GPUs if we accept preemptible pricing; ETA 25m. I'm authorizing.

Camila R: once quota arrives, autoscaler should be able to attach. But we should also fix the autoscaler logic that disallows attach when spare <2 — that's making it brittle under partial quota. Will schedule a safety patch.

Alice M: handing off to Marc and Camila for follow-up work and postmortem. I'll stay on for the next 30m for validation.

Marc V: taking postmortem lead (will collect logs, timeline, config changes). Primary remediation tasks:
- fix autoscaler attach/backoff logic
- add graceful degradation policy for node-attach failures
- refine routing policy to allow sticky sessions to migrate safely

Lina T: also recommend runbook update: add immediate check for region GPU quotas before rollout of autoscaler changes.

OpsBot: NOTE: Incident severity remains P1 until east1 queue < 50 and error-rate < 1.5x baseline. Next update at +15m.

Alice M: thanks team. initial postmortem labels: capacity-exhaustion, autoscale-regression, cross-region-routing. Closing oncall for now — leaving handoff to Marc V and Camila R.

Marc V: acknowledged. I'll postops in ~2h with timeline and customer impact details.

Support Bot: Notifying affected customers list with follow-up note mentioning mitigation steps and ETA.

Camila R: note for follow-up: include autoscaler logs snippet showing AttachError pattern and the patch ref.

Oncall Pager: incident thread closed for active paging at 1973003160. If any regression appears, re-paging will occur. :lock_with_ink_pen:
